name: Never log secrets or tokens
content: Do not pass credentials, API keys, or bearer tokens to a logger. Redact the value or log a stable identifier instead.

name: Use the centralized logger instead of print
content: Application code must emit diagnostics through the shared logger so output is structured and routed correctly. Reserve print() for CLI user-facing output.

name: Parameterize SQL queries
content: Build SQL with bound parameters rather than string interpolation so user input cannot alter the query.

name: Set a timeout on outbound HTTP calls
content: Every outbound HTTP request must set an explicit timeout so a slow upstream cannot exhaust the caller's connection pool.

name: Assert on behavior, not on call counts
content: Prefer asserting the observable result of a unit over asserting that a collaborator was called. Mock-call assertions couple tests to the implementation.
